newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Five die as nine Indonesian churches torched.
newsitem.headline: Five die as nine Indonesian churches torched.

text.p: Five people died after being trapped in a burning church when a rampaging crowd destroyed nine churches and a number of Christian schools in the Indonesian town of Situbondo, police said on Friday.
A policeman in Situbondo, 800 km (500 miles) east of Jakarta on Java island, told Reuters by telephone that the crowd also destroyed a court building during the violence on Thursday.
"It is true the churches were burnt," said the policeman, who did not identify himself before the line to the local police station was cut-off.
"The victims were inside a church. Five died. There were no injured as they all ran away. The five died inside a church," he said.
He said nine churches, four schools and a convent were burnt. "There was lots (of other damage) including three cars (burnt)," he added.
He said a number of people had been detained. The cause of the violence and whether it had been organised was not known, he added, saying it was still under investigation.
